body:
The acceptance tests for TEXTKIT-123 contain a conflict:

- `test_duplicate_anchors` expects `table_of_contents("# Notes\n#### Notes\n## Notes\n")` to produce `"- [Notes](#notes)\n  - [Notes](#notes-2)"`
- `test_regression_issue_1140` expects the same input to produce `"- [Notes](#notes)\n  - [Notes](#notes-1)"`

Per the design-review note for TEXTKIT-123: "The renderer numbers every heading, including headings hidden by max_level, so those still consume a number." This means the hidden `#### Notes` heading should consume a number, making the third heading `notes-2`.

The implementation in `src/textkit/table_of_contents.py` follows the spec correctly (producing `notes-2`). The `test_regression_issue_1140` expectation appears to be incorrect and contradicts the documented spec. Please review and fix the regression test.
